Subject: Notification of My Departure - October 15th

Dear Sarah,

I am writing to inform you that, after careful consideration, I have decided to resign from my position as Marketing Manager, effective two weeks from the date of this email. My last day of work will be October 15th.

I am leaving to pursue a new opportunity that aligns with my career goals and personal aspirations. I want to express my sincere gratitude to you and the entire team for the support and experience I have gained during my time here. I appreciate the opportunities I have had to grow and develop as a professional, and I am grateful for the knowledge and skills I have acquired.

I will do my best to ensure a smooth transition of my responsibilities and complete any outstanding tasks before my departure. If there is anything specific you would like me to focus on during my remaining time here, please let me know.

Thank you again for the opportunity to work with such a great team. I wish the company continued success in the future.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
